description: This file defines the interface PaymentService, which declares methods for handling various payment-related operations in the e-commerce system, such as retrieving payment methods, processing payments and refunds, managing configurations, and validation.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for managing payment processes, configurations, validation, and retrieval of payment modules in the system.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available payment modules for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Fetches the configuration details for payment modules associated with a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Handles the processing of a payment given customer, store, payment details, cart items, and order.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for an order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module based on a specific payment type (e.g., CREDITCARD).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its code (e.g., paypal, authorizenet).

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration details for a payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates the credit card information provided.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the payment configuration for a specific module.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes a capture payment for an order.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of accepted payment methods for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Fetches a payment module based on its code.
